name: Cold-Flame Atronach
location: The Black Forge, Outside the Library of Dusk

abilities.name: Flare
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that deals minor flame damage.

abilities.name: Radiance
abilities.description: The atronach surrounds itself in an aura of flames, dealing continuous low flame damage to all nearby targets.

abilities.name: Lava Geyser
abilities.description: The atronach summons a pillar of flame from the ground at its target's location, indicated by a red circle, dealing moderate flame damage.

abilities.name: Combustion
abilities.description: When defeated, the atronach explodes, indicated by a growing red circle, dealing moderate flame damage to targets caught in the blast.

notes: The Cold Flame Atronach Wolf is an atronach bound in the form of a wolf for use as a mount.
Garrison defense in the Imperial City's Nobles District
Flame Atronachs in the following locations are cold-flame blue but are not labeled as such:
related_quests: Dark Anchors in Tamriel: Help destroy Dark Anchors in Tamriel.
Valley of Blades: Retrieve the Ring of Stendarr's Mercy from the Valley of Blades.
Vanus Unleashed: Prevent the Daedra from using Galerion's essence to power the Planemeld.
summary: Cold-Flame Atronachs are the freezing opposite of their better-known cousins, the flame atronach. They serve as sentries in Coldharbour where one would expect to find a normal flame atronach. A book has been written on the subject. Friendly cold-flame atronachs can be summoned in Oathsworn Pit, while fighting Grubduthag Many-Fates.
